Everything used to be sold as one-off builds, but that has changed. Connect was never $200 a month with no setup and it is no longer sold that way, and the old Deluxe price of $5,000 plus $300 a month was retired, so you should not quote either of those.

Instead of fixed prices, we now say our pricing depends entirely on the scope of your project. Reach out for a custom quote and we'll figure out the number together after a discovery call, because we don't publish a rate card anymore.
